subject: loop: a run that wrote its work finishes on silence instead of failing as lost
prompt:
A run that did its work is failed as "provider lost" because the model never wrote a closing line. Free-route gpt-oss:120b does not write a final message: on one run it edited the parser, passed acceptance in 31 s, and the empty-completion guard in the agent loop (packages/orchestrator/src/agent-loop.ts) then retried its empty replies and ended the run with `provider_lost` — a passed task reported as a failure.

The guard is right to retry a run that has produced nothing, and it already accepts a silent finish from a run that narrated earlier: one nudge, then the finish stands with a notice. It does not do the same for a run that has already written files, which has a result the user can read even without a closing line.

What should happen: a run that wrote files and then goes silent gets the same treatment as a run that narrated earlier — one nudge, then the run finishes on the work — with a notice saying that the edits are the result (the notice must contain "the edits above are the result"). The finish gates still run after that as they do today (a write with no check is still refused once), and the run ends with `end_turn`, not an error. A read-only run with no answer at all is still an error.

Keep the existing exported APIs working, and keep the existing tests passing.
